Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

If the upgradation is to Level 14 or above of the Pay Matrix, he shall be given the option to draw the upgraded basic pay under such Pro forma Promotion without Deputation (Duty) Allowance or the pay which he was drawing before grant of Pro forma Promotion with Deputation (Duty) Allowance, whichever is more beneficial as per the option of the officer.
